title: BOC eyes P7 million from sale of 4 Maserati luxury vehicles

blocks.text: MANILA – The government expects to generate at least PHP7 million from the recent sale of four Maserati Levante luxury vehicles, the Bureau of Customs (BOC) said Saturday. In a news relase, the BOC said Fast Car Traders Corp. submitted four separate offers amounting to PHP7,055,664 for the luxury cars. The vehicles include two 2021 Maserati Levante Modena units, with accepted offers of PHP1,594,388 and PHP1,601,000, respectively, as well as two 2021 Maserati Levante GT Hybrid units, with accepted offers of PHP1,930,088 and PHP1,930,188, respectively.
